requirement.description: The external() function is incorrectly handling bytes objects in the __eq__ method, causing AttributeError when trying to access '.items' on bytes objects.
requirement.contract: When comparing external() objects with bytes values, the comparison should properly handle bytes objects without attempting to call .items() method on them. The external() function should correctly handle both string and bytes comparisons.

requirement.description: The UUID storage is not properly locating external files when using the uuid storage protocol, resulting in KeyError when accessing external files.
requirement.contract: When using uuid storage protocol, the lookup mechanism should properly locate and return external files based on their UUID stems. The _lookup_path method should correctly resolve UUID-based file paths.

requirement.description: The external() function is not correctly handling the creation of external files when the name parameter is None or empty, leading to issues with snapshot creation.
requirement.contract: When creating external() objects without a name parameter, the function should properly initialize and handle the storage of external values without raising KeyError or similar issues.

requirement.description: The UUID storage implementation has issues with the _external_files property caching mechanism, preventing proper file lookup in certain scenarios.
requirement.contract: The _external_files property should properly cache and return all external files available in the test directories and ensure that file lookups work correctly regardless of test directory configuration.

requirement.description: The external() function doesn't properly handle the case when the external file is not found during loading, causing KeyError instead of graceful error handling.
requirement.contract: When an external file cannot be located during loading, the external() function should provide meaningful error messages instead of raising KeyError exceptions.
